purpose.summary: Add a persistent, reversible Chronik token-index runtime core for accepted ALP and SLP transaction streams while keeping the runtime unlinked from the node and outside every consensus decision.
scope: Introduce the independently authored chronik-runtime crate over the donor-bound Chronik database, transaction and ALP/SLP verification primitives accepted in ERGON-CHANGE-0035.
Atomically persist accepted block identity, ordered transaction reverse lookups, token ancestry, token metadata and genesis payloads, then reconstruct the indexed tip after restart.
Require exact height and parent continuity on connect and exact tip identity plus ordered transaction identity on disconnect.
Exercise ALP genesis, mint, send and burn persistence, restart, exact-tip rollback, ordering contradictions and failed-validation atomicity.
Include the runtime in the default-off locked Rust build and CI corpus while preserving the existing node-independent build graph.
exclusions: No node callback, startup option, datadir binding, block-file reader, mempool hook, HTTP, gRPC, websocket or public query API is added.
No consensus, validation, activation, chain-selection, wallet, P2P, network identity or mainnet parameter change is included.
No private history, private source, operator data, incoming report, binary, build output or host-specific path is tracked.

limitations: This lot creates a persistent token-index runtime library but does not yet connect accepted node events, startup reconstruction or reorg callbacks to it.
The runtime currently exposes only a Rust library query for token ancestry; no public node API, mempool view or subscription surface exists.
The runtime trusts its future host adapter to supply accepted active-chain blocks in exact order; binary-to-source and block-file provenance remain outside this library boundary.
The local Rust run is a component observation only; no public CI receipt exists before publication and no result is promoted to Observed or Reproduced here.
The dependency closure is locked, but native compiler, libclang and RocksDB build outputs are not bit-reproducibly pinned by this record.
counterevidence: The pinned donor chronik-cpp bridge targets a newer Bitcoin ABC node API and cannot be copied directly into Bitcoin Static v24.0.5 without unsafe assumptions about validation callbacks, HTTP services and chain interfaces.
The staged implementation therefore stops at a host-neutral persistent runtime and leaves the Bitcoin Static adapter to a separate reviewed change.
A failed cyclic-token batch is required to leave no indexed tip, transaction reverse lookup or token record behind.
Any node link edge, startup registration, API exposure, consensus effect, dependency drift or unreviewed path must fail this lot boundary.
